TC-24/S30.title: A second device has the chart open when the patient is deleted: the chart stops showing it, nothing is written back, drafts recorded
TC-24/S30.detail: Our own addition (record-only; a write-back would have been a bug). PW, local stack, one physician on two devices. B had the Hospital chart open and had just typed 'Overnight afebrile, HR 76, plan to recheck BMP.' into the pre-round editor; A deleted the patient from its card (native confirm accepted - the native dialog itself is known B24). B, without a reload, replaced the chart with 'Patient not found.' + 'Back to rounds' 91 ms after the delete (name and diagnosis gone, not a blank screen); Save Note was no longer on screen, so it could not be pressed. B's pending autosave did send one rounding:update 84 ms after the delete (rounding.update only patches an existing row and throws 'Patient not found'). Nothing was written back: rounding:get(id) stayed null, no row with the name or B's text appeared, A's list does not show it, also after B reloaded. Recorded for Q6(c) / decision D5: B's session-draft store keeps '<user>:<chartId>:preRoundNotes' = the typed sentence after the delete and after the reload (cleared only at sign-out).
